sam: Proposing Elmwood dedicated rollout Mon 01:00-02:00 UTC. Need KMS check, canary plan, and rollback gates. Can we lock? 

nora: KMS: no rotations that night. +1. I'll attach compliance note.

ops_bot: Ops: recommend 8% canary on 3 nodes for 25m, then 40% for 15m. Rollback triggers: >1% errors over 10m OR p95 latency increase >700ms. Set drain grace to 30s.

sam: We'll pin runtime image to runtime:v2.4.1.0-stable (kvcache GC + batching fix). Nora: QA status?

nora: QA: ran smoke harness on mirrored slice against v2.4.1.0-stable. Two smoke prompts pass. Observed ~4% embed latency increase; acceptable. Smoke files attached.

deploybot: created job:
```
job: elmwood-dedicated-rollout
image: redwood/runtime:v2.4.1.0-stable
canary: 8% for 25m -> 40% for 15m -> 100%
post_checks: smoke-basic.txt
rollback: pin-to v2.4.0-stable
```

audit: Audit: retain KMS access logs 180 days for Elmwood per contract.

sam: Ops runbook linked, oncall is ops_bot (kevin). Locking quiet window. If no objections by 18:00 UTC I'll mark approved and schedule. :shipit:
